svg.title: Brewer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as brewer, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A domed brewing kettle has a short upper neck, straight body and clearly projecting low outlet tap. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
